purpose: Teach: ホセ/ブライアン/アダム/チャイルド/エリック/ビリー/アンナ/ソロモン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスペイン人のホセ・カレーラスのCDを聴いてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is listening to a CD of José Carreras, the Spanish tenor.
lines.style: Gentle, informative tone. Warm affection for both son and husband. Measured pace, like sharing a small, pleasant observation from another room. Slightly knowing smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとブライアン・メイのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about Brian May with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick tempo, words tumbling out. Opening attack is energetic—he's excited to share. Slight breathiness from enthusiasm. Natural child-voice lightness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「アダム・スミスは経済学の祖」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was teaching you that Adam Smith is the father of economics.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Slight wonder in the voice—noticing and appreciating the moment her husband is sharing knowledge. Unhurried. Warm but observant, like she's taking it in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとチャイルドケア施設の見学に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to see a childcare facility!
lines.style: Eager, quick tempo. Opening attack is bright. The words come easily—he's proud of the outing. Small-child directness and openness. Slight rise at the end, inviting her to share in the excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエリック・カルマンの動画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a video by Eric Kármán.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Gentle observation in her tone. Unhurried pace. Like she's noticing what her husband is interested in and sharing it with affection. Slight trailing quality—not quite surprised, but warmly aware.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとビリー・ホリデイの伝記映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a biography film about Billie Holiday with Dad!
lines.style: Eager, animated delivery. Quick pace. Opening attack is bright and direct. Enthusiasm carries him through the sentence. Child-simple and genuine excitement—he's proud to tell her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「アンナ・パブロワのバレエは伝説的」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying that Anna Pavlova's ballet was legendary.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Gentle appreciation in the voice—she's noticing something her husband said and turning it over thoughtfully. Warm, unhurried pace. Slight wondering quality, like she's moved by his knowledge.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとソロモン王の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read a picture book about King Solomon together!
lines.style: Warm, satisfied delivery. Slower than his usual eager tempo—a moment of contentment. Soft, genuine smile in the voice. Opening with gentle brightness. Trailing off softly at the end, savoring the memory.
